единицы.утверждение_en: Be specific: more details give you more control over the generated image.
единицы.цитата: Be specific: More details give you more control.
единицы.раздел: Gemini image generation best practices / Be specific

единицы.утверждение_en: Instead of a vague prompt like "fantasy armor", use a detailed one: "ornate elven plate armor, etched with silver leaf patterns, with a high collar and pauldrons shaped like falcon wings."
единицы.цитата:
instead of
"fantasy armor," try "ornate elven plate armor, etched with silver leaf
patterns, with a high collar and pauldrons shaped like falcon wings."
единицы.раздел: Gemini image generation best practices / Be specific
единицы.заметка: Структура детализации: [эпитет качества "ornate"] + [культура/стиль "elven"] + [тип "plate armor"] → [отделка и материал "etched with silver leaf patterns"] → [конкретные части с формой "high collar", "pauldrons shaped like falcon wings"]. Работу делают материалы, узор и сравнение формы с узнаваемым объектом.

единицы.утверждение_en: Provide context and intent: explain the purpose of the image to help the model understand the context.
единицы.цитата:
Provide context and intent: Explain the purpose of the image to help the
model understand the context.
единицы.раздел: Gemini image generation best practices / Provide context and intent

единицы.утверждение_en: "Create a logo for a high-end, minimalist skincare brand" works better than "Create a logo."
единицы.цитата:
"Create a logo for a high-end,
minimalist skincare brand" works better than "Create a logo."
единицы.раздел: Gemini image generation best practices / Provide context and intent
единицы.заметка: Структура: [что создать "Create a logo"] + [для кого/зачем "for a … skincare brand"] + [позиционирование и эстетика "high-end, minimalist"]. Работу делает назначение, из которого модель выводит стиль.

единицы.утверждение_en: Iterate and refine: don't expect a perfect image on the first attempt; use follow-up prompts to make small changes.
единицы.цитата:
Iterate and refine: Don't expect a perfect image on your first attempt.
Use follow-up prompts to make small changes
единицы.раздел: Gemini image generation best practices / Iterate and refine

единицы.утверждение_en: Follow-up refinement prompts: "Make the lighting warmer" or "Change the character's expression to be more serious."
единицы.цитата:
"Make the lighting
warmer" or "Change the character's expression to be more serious."
единицы.раздел: Gemini image generation best practices / Iterate and refine
единицы.заметка: Структура правки: повелительный глагол (Make / Change) + один элемент (lighting / character's expression) + направление изменения (warmer / more serious). Одна правка за ход, без пересказа сцены.

единицы.утверждение_en: Use step-by-step instructions: for complex scenes, split your request into steps.
единицы.цитата:
Use step-by-step instructions: For complex scenes, split your request
into steps.
единицы.раздел: Gemini image generation best practices / Use step-by-step instructions

единицы.утверждение_en: Step-by-step prompt: "First, create a background of a serene, misty forest at dawn. Then, in the foreground, add a moss-covered ancient stone altar. Finally, place a single, glowing sword on top of the altar."
единицы.цитата:
"First, create a background of a serene, misty
forest at dawn. Then, in the foreground, add a moss-covered ancient stone
altar. Finally, place a single, glowing sword on top of the altar."
единицы.раздел: Gemini image generation best practices / Use step-by-step instructions
единицы.заметка: Структура: маркеры порядка First / Then / Finally; слои идут от фона (background: forest at dawn, с настроением serene, misty) к переднему плану (foreground: altar) и к фокусному объекту (sword on top of the altar). Каждое предложение — один слой с явным пространственным указанием и глаголом действия (create / add / place).

единицы.утверждение_en: Describe what you want, not what you don't: describe the scene positively instead of stating exclusions.
единицы.цитата:
Describe what you want, not what you don't: Instead of saying "no cars",
describe the scene positively
единицы.раздел: Gemini image generation best practices / Describe what you want, not what you don't

единицы.утверждение_en: Instead of "no cars", say "an empty, deserted street with no signs of traffic."
единицы.цитата:
Instead of saying "no cars",
describe the scene positively by saying, "an empty, deserted street with no
signs of traffic."
единицы.раздел: Gemini image generation best practices / Describe what you want, not what you don't
единицы.заметка: Структура: вместо запрета объекта описано желаемое состояние сцены (empty, deserted street). Заметка: сама позитивная версия всё же содержит "with no signs of traffic" — правило нацелено на голый запрет ("no cars"), а не на полное отсутствие отрицаний.

единицы.утверждение_en: Control the camera: guide the camera view by using photographic and cinematic terms to describe the composition.
единицы.цитата:
Control the camera: Guide the camera view. Use photographic and
cinematic terms to describe the composition
единицы.раздел: Gemini image generation best practices / Control the camera

единицы.утверждение_en: Camera/composition terms to use: "wide-angle shot", "macro shot", or "low-angle perspective".
единицы.раздел: Gemini image generation best practices / Control the camera
единицы.заметка: Фрагменты промпта, а не полные промпты: тип объектива/плана (wide-angle, macro) и ракурс (low-angle perspective).

единицы.утверждение_en: Prompt for images: describe the intent with phrases such as "create an image of" or "generate an image of".
единицы.цитата:
Prompt for images: Describe the intent by using phrases such as "create
an image of" or "generate an image of".
единицы.раздел: Gemini image generation best practices / Prompt for images

единицы.утверждение_en: Without such phrasing, the multimodal model might respond with text instead of the image.
единицы.цитата:
Otherwise, the multimodal model
might respond with text instead of the image.
единицы.раздел: Gemini image generation best practices / Prompt for images

единицы.утверждение_en: When using Gemini, Google recommends passing thought signatures back to the model during multi-turn image creation and editing to preserve reasoning context across interactions.
единицы.цитата:
When using
Gemini, we recommend that you pass thought signatures
back to the model during multi-turn image creation and editing. This lets
you preserve reasoning context across interactions.
единицы.раздел: Gemini image generation best practices / Pass Thought Signatures
единицы.заметка: Код — по ссылке "Example of multi-turn image editing using thought signatures" (на странице кода нет).

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: The page's own examples model a complete prompt workflow: state the image intent explicitly ('create an image of'), give purpose and concrete details, phrase exclusions as positive scene states, name the camera view, build complex scenes in ordered layers (background → foreground → focal object), then refine with one small change per follow-up turn.
длинная_дистанция.заметка: Сводка восьми пунктов в порядок работы; сам порядок страница не задаёт — это упорядочивание по логике примеров.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: Iterative refinement through follow-up prompts is the recommended path to a good image, and in API use it depends on passing thought signatures back between turns to keep reasoning context.

The positive-phrasing rule targets bare exclusions ('no cars'): the recommended rewrite describes the desired state of the scene (empty, deserted street), even though it still includes a qualifying 'with no signs of traffic'.
длинная_дистанция.раздел: Describe what you want, not what you don't

противоречия_внутри: Нюанс, не прямое противоречие: пункт 'Describe what you want, not what you don't' в качестве позитивного примера даёт фразу с отрицанием 'with no signs of traffic'.
